description: A quiet summer duckling companion in a straw hat and goggles, floating in a blue-white swim ring beside a daisy stool and a flowered woven bag.

idle.notes: Calm breathing companion pose with the stool and woven bag resting quietly beside Brim.

walk.notes: Directional scene-glide rows used for right-facing and left-facing drag behavior, not literal walking.

curious.notes: Soft curious glance toward the nearby bag and stool while keeping the vacation scene composed.

happy.notes: Gentle pleased uplift with a tiny swim-ring bounce and restrained wave.

sleep.notes: Drowsy resting loop with closed eyes and a tucked, quiet summer companion posture.

active.notes: Gentle buoyant support loop with in-place bobbing and tiny delayed bag sway.

hop.notes: Very small buoyant support hop that keeps the full companion scene together.

melancholy.notes: Tender low-energy droop that preserves Brim's calm charm without dramatic distress.

roll_right.notes: Entire Brim scene glides right while preserving the relative stool-and-bag arrangement.

roll_left.notes: Entire Brim scene glides left while preserving the relative stool-and-bag arrangement.

drag.notes: Directional drag uses true facing scene-glide rows; this is not a normal walk cycle.

active_support.notes: Extra support loop retained to complete the fixed atlas.

hop_support.notes: Extra support loop retained to complete the fixed atlas.

low_energy_support.notes: Extra support loop retained to complete the fixed atlas.

dragFacingValidation.rule: deltaX < 0 => facing left; deltaX > 0 => facing right

right drag uses the true right-facing scene-glide row
left and right rows are not swapped
straw hat brim, goggles, beak direction, swim ring, stool, and woven bag all agree with drag direction
